name: Packaging Corporation of America

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (Packaging Corporation of America logo.svg)

description: Packaging Corporation of America makes the brown paper (linerboard and corrugating medium, together 'containerboard') used for cardboard boxes and converts most of it into corrugated boxes and displays in its own plants. It says it is the third largest containerboard producer in North America (per industry sources and its own estimates) and runs ten mills and 91 corrugated products plants. About 92% of sales are the Packaging segment (boxes and containerboard); the rest is a small uncoated freesheet office-paper business whose biggest customer, ODP (Office Depot), takes 58% of that segment's sales. In September 2025 it bought Greif's containerboard business for $1.8B in cash, adding two mills of about 800,000 tons and eight plants.
